entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve cli deployment of iOS and Android to be more agent friendly #32455
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [Epic] Improve on the agent story inside the .NET MAUI Repository #32454
    .NET 11 Planning
  • When the version of CommunityToolkit.Maui is greater than 9.1.1, EventToCommandBehavior does not work #32442
  • Maui controls (CheckBox) alignment issue in .NET 10 compared to .NET 9 when placed inside Grid #32440
  • Suggestion: Also allow us to write x:Class="views:DetailPage" instead of x:Class="Xyz.Views.DetailPage" #32439
  • HybridWebView in Windows .NET 9 cannot take json string arguments (must base64 the string) #32438
  • [.NET 10] The gap in the bottom of the emulator increases while scrolling. #32436
  • [.NET 10]I1_Add_Items_Linear_Layout - Rotating the Simulator causes the text on the collection view to disappear. #32435
  • [Windows] MAUI Label LineHeight is not same in .NET 9 and .NET 10 #32434

Closed

  • Android App Crashes When Battery Saver Enabled #32445
  • Disregard, error #32450
  • [Android] Refactor WindowInsetListener to per-CoordinatorLayout registry with optimized lookups #32301
    .NET 10.0 SR1
  • Default MAUI project template doesn't compile. "Xaml Internal Error error WMC9999: Name cannot begin with the '<' character, hexadecimal value 0x3C." #31794
    .NET 11 Planning
  • System.InvalidOperationException: PlatformView cannot be null here when using Switch inside BindableLayout #31569
  • The RealParent on Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes.RoundRectangle has been Garbage Collected #31780

Created

  • Fix MAUIG1001 error by adding binary compatibility overload for GenerateBindingMethod #32453
  • [iOS] Replace Thread.Sleep with robust wait mechanism in CarouselView2 tests #32452
  • [iOS] Fix DatePicker to consistently display 4-digit years #32451
    platform/ios, p/0, area-controls-datetimepicker, .NET 10.0 SR1

  • [Android] Optimize MauiWindowInsetListener registry with ConditionalWeakTable #32447
  • [testing] Refactor Xaml unit tests to Xunit #32446

  • [XSG] better AppThemeBinding #32441
    xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2

    platform/android, partner/syncfusion
